known_unknowns.question: Why does UNESCO not run a symmetric biennium-end protocol mirroring FM revenue transfer with PS budget transfer (KBW1 cross-project), WBS TECO/CLSD on legacy, PO reassignment ME22N, and Workplan update? known_unknowns.answer: UNESCO does NOT have a formal protocol for biennium-end closeout. Confirmed by user (Session #69, 2026-05-01). No written SOP, no cross-biennium WBS-mapping table, no documented end-to-end owner. The biennium-end is operated as 5 independent ad-hoc actions by separate teams (Finance does FB01 R1 batch; Programme does Workplan reprogramming; PS team does TECO/CLSD when manually triggered; MM team does ME22N PO reassignment if requested; nobody synchronizes the 5).
known_unknowns.implication: This eliminates Plan A (formalize existing SOP). The gap is BOTH organizational (no SOP exists) AND technical (no enforcement). FIX-B requires building a SOP from scratch, FIX-C requires creating master-data mapping that does not exist. Therefore: FIX-E (HARD-BLOCK BAdI) and FIX-F (Meta-AVC) become the load-bearing solutions because they enforce consistency without requiring the missing organizational layer.

known_unknowns.title: OKB9 typo silently fails when target cost center doesn't exist in CSKS
known_unknowns.description: When OKB9 (TKA3D) BArIn grid contains a Cost Center value that does NOT exist in CSKS for the same KOKRS, SAP does NOT raise an error at OKB9 maintenance time. At posting time, the BArIn lookup retrieves the invalid cost center, fails to find it in CSKS, and silently skips → KOSTL is left empty in BSEG. The posting succeeds but with KOSTL=blank, which then causes downstream issues (no profit center derivation via CSKS, missing CO actual data). Specific instance INC-8088 V01 2026-05-07: 7044013 OKB9 entry had GEF row Cost Ctr=3001 (typo, should be 113001). Cost center 0000003001 does not exist in CSKS UNES; 0000113001 does (text: 'Exch rate / int- GEF'). Test posting on SOG-DKK1 NINT credit landed on 7044013 with Fund=GEF, FundCenter=UNESCO, KOSTL=blank. The agent reviewed the OKB9 screenshot showing 'GEF | 3001' alongside 'MBF | 143001 / OPF | 133001' (4-digit vs 6-digit pattern anomaly) and FAILED to flag it as a typo — Class-of-defect: agent must validate per-row OKB9 BArIn entries against CSKS before assuming derivation works.
known_unknowns.next_step: 1) Fix OKB9 7044013 GEF row 3001 -> 113001. 2) Re-post test statement. 3) Add agent rule: ANY OKB9 screenshot must be validated digit-by-digit against CSKS for the same KOKRS — flag any 4-digit cost center where 6-digit is the norm.
